description: This file defines API routes for managing notes in a backend application using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes. The functions utilize flow modules for core operations and handle database sessions and error responses.

methods.name: TagOut _to_tag_out(t)
methods.description: Converts a tag object to TagOut schema.

methods.name: NoteOut _to_note_out(n, tags)
methods.description: Converts a note object and its associated tags to NoteOut schema.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: UUID, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))

methods.name: update_note(note_id: UUID, payload: NoteUpdate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))

methods.description: Handles DELETE request to delete a note.
